faction-wars.name: Faction Wars
faction-wars.description: The original roster: Digi-Destined partners, Tamers, Savers, Frontier and Xros Wars lines, with Royal Knights and Demon Lords at 5 cost. Hyper Roll rules and Data Wisps.
faction-wars.mechanicDescription: Every other round from stage 2, a one-use Data Wisp sits in the sixth shop slot. It costs its base price plus the stage number and leaves at the end of the round.

fates.name: Fates
fates.description: Partner Digimon: some shop slots offer a Champion-form Partner whose marked trait counts double. One Partner at a time. Hyper Roll rules, Digi-Forge artifacts.
fates.mechanicDescription: From level 4 a shop slot can offer a Partner: a Champion-form Digimon (like 3 copies) for 3 times its cost. Its marked trait counts twice, and it gains 200 HP plus one bonus (300 HP, 40 ability power, 20% attack damage or 20% lower max mana). You can own one Partner at a time; sell it to see more. You see at least one by round 2-2.

galaxies.name: Galaxies
galaxies.description: TFT Set 3 on Digimon: DigiDestined, Dark Area, DigiXros fusions and Data Pirates. Every game rolls one Galaxy, a rule that changes the game for every Tamer.
galaxies.mechanicDescription: Every game rolls one Galaxy from the seed, the same for every Tamer, and shows it at the start of the game. A Galaxy changes the rules for the whole game: extra items, free rerolls, bigger teams, copies of your Digimon and more. File Island and Big Bang are twice as likely as the others.

gizmos.name: Gizmos & Gadgets
gizmos.description: Inventors, pirates and Dark Masters in a gadget city. Three Digivice upgrades per game in Silver, Gold and Prismatic, with the tiers shown in advance by Hextech Gates.
gizmos.mechanicDescription: Three Digivice upgrades per game (2-1, 3-2, 4-2), in Silver, Gold or Prismatic tiers. The tiers of all three rounds are rolled for the whole lobby when the game starts and shown on every upgrade pick. Silver gates also give every Tamer a component and 4 gold, Gold gates 2 gold.

reckoning.name: Reckoning
reckoning.description: The Dark Spore spreads: Shadow items trade a drawback for power, and the Radiant Blessing lifts Tamers who fall low. Hyper Roll rules.
reckoning.mechanicDescription: Spore components make Shadow items: stronger, with a drawback. Every item has a Radiant upgrade, offered at the 4-1 Radiant Armory and by the Radiant Blessing, which comes once when you drop low.

dragonlands.name: Dragonlands
dragonlands.description: Mega Dragons that take two team slots, a Treasure Dragon round, Golden Armor gold items and fixed augment rounds with one reroll. Hyper Roll rules.
dragonlands.mechanicDescription: Dragons take 2 team slots, cost more and count as 3 for their marked trait. Round 4-4 is a Treasure Dragon whose loot you pick at 5-1. Augments come at 2-1, 3-2 and 4-2 with one reroll for the game.

arcane.name: Into the Arcane
arcane.description: Kowloon gangs, the Bagra Army, DigiPolice and the Rebels. At 4-3 you mutate one Digimon with an Anomaly; Syndicate Digimon trade Shimmer at the black market. Hyper Roll rules.
arcane.mechanicDescription: At 4-3, pick one of 3 Anomalies for the Digimon on your board's center hex (column 4, second row); if it is empty, your strongest Digimon gets it. Rerolls cost 1 gold. The mutation (X-Antibody, DNA Digivolution or Digital Hazard) lasts the whole game and stays through digivolving. Each game also opens a random portal, and the Kowloon Syndicate runs a black market.

coliseum.name: K.O. Coliseum
coliseum.description: A Digimon fighting tournament. Feed Digi-Cores to pick digivolution paths, choose Justimon's arm and Labramon's partner, and bank gems with Jewel Gambit. Plays at Hyper Roll or Normal pace.
coliseum.mechanicDescription: At set rounds (1-3 and 3-3 in Hyper Roll, 1-3 and 3-6 in Normal) every Tamer gets a Digi-Core. Drag it onto a Digimon to pick 1 of 3 digivolution paths for it; selling that Digimon gives the Digi-Core back. Justimon and Labramon pick a form when you get them.

underlords.name: Undermons
underlords.description: Undermons: 26 alliances, tiered items with no recipes, creep rounds, and a Tamer on your board from round 10 who ranks up every 5 rounds.
underlords.mechanicDescription: At round 10 each player picks a Tamer (offered with one of two builds). The Tamer fights on the board without using a team slot, uses abilities on cooldowns and ranks up every 5 rounds. Losing to a player gives a free reroll next round.

autochess.name: Auto Chess
autochess.description: Auto Chess: races and classes, 2-copy Druids, Wizards, creep loot, interest and XP.
autochess.mechanicDescription: Creep rounds (1, 2, 3, then every fifth round from 10) drop items: win and pick 1 of 3 next round, lose and get one random item. Relics at 3-2, 5-2 and 7-2.

underlords_ko.name: Undermons Knockout
underlords_ko.description: Undermons Knockout: 4 lives, 2 copies digivolve, a starter crew, an item every other round and a Tamer from round 2. About 10 minutes.
underlords_ko.mechanicDescription: At round 10 each player picks a Tamer (offered with one of two builds). The Tamer fights on the board without using a team slot, uses abilities on cooldowns and ranks up every 5 rounds. Losing to a player gives a free reroll next round.

chaos.name: Chaos
chaos.description: A random set every game, picked from the game seed.
